thread:
Maya: Hey team — planning to spin up a new GPU nodepool in me-central1 for a low-latency trial with customers in ME/EMEA. Want this to be taint-aware (gpu:latency=high:NoSchedule), preemptible-friendly, and with a fallback to eu-west4 for heavy egress. Need quick sanity checks: quotas, egress IPs, and autoscaler sizing.

Jon: Question — what's the expected steady qps and egress pattern? cross-region egress costs can blow up if model downloads or large responses happen.

Maya: Target steady: ~300 qps across plats initially, bursty up to 900 qps. Most outputs are small (tokens), but customers will occasionally request batch exports (~2GB/day total).

Sergey: Quota heads-up: me-central1 currently has 0 GPUs allocated for us. We can request 8 A10G as a start. A100/H100 would be overkill for this trial cost-wise. If we want spot/preemptible, we should size with ~30% headroom for evictions.

Tia: Autoscaler suggestion: min 0, max 10 nodes (A10G). Use node-group annotation for cluster-autoscaler to prefer non-preemptible fallback. Also add pod priority class for customer-critical workloads so they survive preemptible churn. Example snippet:
```
resource "kubernetes_node_pool" "me_gpus" {
  node_count = 0
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 0 max_node_count = 10 }
  taints = ["gpu:latency=high:NoSchedule"]
}
# CA annotations on the node pool to support scale-to-zero and priority
```

infra-bot: quota-check: GPUs available in me-central1 for project-redwood: 0/8 (soft quota). Recommended action: file quota increase to 8 A10G. ETA for approval ~24-72h. :thinking_face:

Ram: Also ensure NAT IP capacity — our current egress NAT in me-central1 has only 2 reserved IPs left. If we scale to 10 nodes and each node uses ephemeral egress via NAT, we can run out and start SNAT collisions. Consider a dedicated NAT gateway with enough static IPs or route egress via eu-west4 for heavy outbound.

Lucy: Network policy: this pool will be in a private cluster vpc. Need to ensure node egress to model-store buckets in us-west1 is allowed and the firewall has the correct tags. Also confirm KMS access for model keys from me-central1.

Jon: For cost: using preemptibles (spot) A10G with a fallback to small on-demand pool in eu-west4 during outages looks cheapest. Suggest a mixed nodepool: 6 spot A10G + 2 on-demand A10G as a buffer. Use node affinity + taints for latency-critical pods to prefer local pool.

Sergey: Implementation checklist I can take: 1) open quota case for 8 A10G in me-central1, 2) PR for terraform nodepool with taints/CA annotations, 3) NAT capacity request / add 4 static egress IPs, 4) smoke test with 50 concurrent gen workers.

Maya: Sounds good. Can you also add a cluster-autoscaler flag to avoid aggressive scale-down during prefix cache warmups? We want a slightly higher cooldown (e.g., 10m).

Tia: Yep — set scaleDownDelayAfterAdd=10m and balance-similar-node-groups=true. Add a liveness probe to the model server to avoid flapping.

Ram: One more: consider enabling cross-region routing policy that pins inference traffic to me-central1 when latency < 80ms, otherwise route to eu-west4. That'll reduce unnecessary cross-region egress.

Maya: Action items: Sergey — file quota + NAT IP request; Jon — draft mixed nodepool sizing PR with taints/priority classes; Lucy — verify firewall/KMS access; Tia — autoscaler config defaults. I'll follow up with product to confirm burst expectations. Thanks all :rocket:

Lucy: I'll also add a short checklist for Security review (KMS+audit logs).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan for branch/feature/me-gpu-nodepool completed (no changes yet).

Maya: I'll leave this open until quota + NAT are confirmed, but feel free to start the PRs.

Jon: I'll open the PR today and tag @Sergey for the quota link.

Sergey: Filed quota case: case-#123456, requested 8 A10G in me-central1. Marking ETA ~48h.

Maya: Perfect — will circle back once quota is approved.
